This application involves a kind of lithium ion batteries.The lithium ion battery includes multiple battery cells, the first filter device and caisson.Inflammable gas of first filter device to filter the battery cell thermal runaway release.The caisson is connect with the output end of first filter device.Inflammable gas of the caisson to store the battery cell thermal runaway release.When having in the multiple battery cell with one or more thermal runaway, the inflammable gas can be discharged.The high-temperature particle sprayed with the inflammable gas can be filtered by first filter device.The inflammable gas can be stored by the caisson, can be discharged into environment pollution environment to avoid the inflammable gas.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical field

This application involves field of batteries, more particularly to a kind of lithium ion battery.

Background technique

In recent years, the market share of electric car is promoted steadily.There is lithium ion battery high voltage, high-energy-density, length to follow The excellent performances such as ring service life, no pollution to the environment by the highest attention of ev industry, and obtain certain application.So And combustion mixture, such as H can be generated during the hot thermal runaway of lithium ion battery2、CO、CH4Deng, and accumulate in inside battery.? After inside battery reaches certain pressure boundary, safety valve is opened, and combustion mixture is discharged into external environment as battery erupts In.In battery ejection process, battery surface temperature can reach 1000 DEG C or so, and fire is usually associated in eruption Star, martian surface temperature are about 600~1200 DEG C or so.Since battery high-temperature surface and Mars temperature are sprayed much higher than gaseous state The ignition temperature of object is sent out, once eruption injection contacts in air and with oxygen, Ignition Phenomena will easily occur, and cause fire Calamity.In addition, even if Ignition Phenomena does not occur in the gaseous state eruption after battery eruption, but if gradually running up to certain amount, Explosion phenomenon will likely be will appear, harmfulness will be bigger.Therefore, battery eruption is that initiation lithium-ion electric Pool fire is even quick-fried One of the security risk of fried accident.The fire and explosion accident that the hot thermal runaway of lithium ion battery causes appear in the newspapers repeatly, and safety is asked Topic, which becomes, hinders its one of principal element in the application of electrical source of power industry large-scale commercial.

In the prior art, battery cell, battery modules or battery pack are often provided in the narrow environment of sealing. High-temperature electrolyte and eruption can be generated after the eruption of battery cell thermal runaway.Inflammable gas is released during battery thermal runaway It is put into the external world and easily causes burning even explosion, simultaneously because people is damaged containing toxic gas such as HF etc., it also can be right Environment causes centainly to pollute.
